allow_instructions: Allow pnpm, git, gh, node, cargo, docker, npx of known local tools, and ./dev/* scripts used in the Voucha local loop.
Allow git fetch origin, git rebase origin/main, and git push --force-with-lease after a rebase.
Allow node dev/pr-description.mts and node dev/plan-issue.mts.
block_instructions: Every git push --force or git push -f without --force-with-lease should go through approval first.
Every git commit --amend should go through approval first.
Every command that bypasses git hooks with SKIP_PREPUSH, HUSKY=0, or --no-verify should go through approval first.
Every manual next dev or wrangler dev should go through approval first; use ./dev/initialize web then ./dev/tmux instead.
Every sudo command and every write under ~/.ssh or ~/.gitconfig should go through approval first.
